svg.title: One in two humans lives on the sunward half of the globe
svg.desc: A three-dimensional globe of Earth in orthographic projection, the continents in Apple system green over a deep-navy ocean, crossed by a faint 30-degree graticule. The sphere rotates eastward, one full turn standing in for one day, so coastlines sweep past the limb exactly as they would on a physical globe. Eight world cities are marked with amber dots and labels as each swings onto the near hemisphere.
svg.text: One in two humans lives on the sunward half of the globe
Orthographic view of Earth, spinning eastward through a full day
Natural Earth land (offline, vendored) — illustrative city set
